observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0006 and the H-006 trial_log entry. H-006 produced negative full-period Sharpe of -0.35122389498871254 and max drawdown of 612.0835%. The strategy failed 5 of 8 D2-006 gates; both long and short legs were negative on net PnL, and Gate 5 passed mechanically only because gross PnL was negative. DEC-0006 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: 30m Bollinger Band squeeze breakout is not promotable under current promotion gates.
The baseline produced negative full-period Sharpe and extreme drawdown, triggering the pre-registered Sharpe and drawdown kill criteria.
Both long and short legs were negative on net PnL, indicating that the squeeze breakout framing did not produce durable follow-through.
Gate 5 passed mechanically because gross PnL was negative; DEC-0006 explicitly warns not to read this as healthy cost behavior.
The result argues for caution before faster 15m breakout expansion because noise, drawdown, and modeled costs dominated this 30m baseline.
